subject.title: Plugin `message_sending` hooks silently bypassed on channel agent-reply delivery paths (2026.5.26, still present in 2026.6.1)

question: Which branch should own the canonical `message_sending` safety-hook repair for configured `beforeDeliver` and Telegram preview-finalized replies?
rationale: The bug is source-proven, but the safe fix is a security-boundary choice because a narrow dispatcher repair can either double-run Telegram delivery-owned hooks or leave streamed finals ungated.

options.title: Use the broad exactly-once branch
options.body: Select or repair https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93216 as canonical after resolving its conflict/draft/proof state because it targets both configured dispatcher delivery and Telegram streamed finals.

options.title: Land a narrow dispatcher repair first
options.body: Select a smaller PR such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92976 for the configured `beforeDeliver` branch, while explicitly keeping preview-finalized streaming as a separate blocker or follow-up.

options.title: Pause for outbound policy design
options.body: Defer all candidate branches until maintainers choose a single unbypassable outbound policy boundary that also addresses broader related hook-coverage issues.

recommendation.title: Use the broad exactly-once branch
recommendation.body: Select or repair https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93216 as canonical after resolving its conflict/draft/proof state because it targets both configured dispatcher delivery and Telegram streamed finals.

likelyOwner.reason: amknight owns the broad assigned candidate PR that already attempts the exactly-once dispatcher and Telegram streamed-final repair.
